adjudication.depicted_input: Figure 1A’s lower pipeline shows the text-side corpus curation path: sampled/standardized cell description text (“Chunk”), retrieval over a database, and the LLM stage that consumes standardized text together with retrieved knowledge to produce enriched text for pretraining.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is too broad because it includes the full pretraining architecture, while the route evidence is specifically the LLM-enriched text curation interface in Figure 1A. A tighter crop within the same figure is defensible: it visibly shows the route-specific text object (“Chunk”/cell description text), the retrieval mechanism (Retriever, Database), and the immediate LLM input path formed from standardized text plus retrieved snippets. Under the atlas rules, the exact variant name and a mandatory model-input textbox are not required when the depicted input mechanism is clear, and pretraining-time inputs are in scope.
